AstraZeneca denies talks for Bristol Myers Squibb takeover

AstraZeneca has denied engaging in discussions regarding a potential takeover of US rival Bristol Myers Squibb. A senior source stated that there were 'no discussions' over such a deal. Earlier reports had suggested the possibility of a merger, which had reportedly met with shareholder apathy and contributed to AstraZeneca falling to third-largest UK company status amid US merger talks.
